findings.text: The repair commit adds a gate row labelled 'Repair: launch-path file at repair head' and cites logs/repair_check_launch_path.log, but that log's own header line records the arm as 'b1cfbd7d302a0eec8390275f8a1e7c7c62afa9c0 plus the repair to tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py (uncommitted)', so the fragment names a revision the log does not. The run is content-identical to the repair head because c0ec02d067 commits exactly those five lines, but a reader reconciling the table against the logs it is the record of finds a revision mismatch, the same class of defect the round-1 review raised against this fragment.

item_verdicts.diff: git diff b1cfbd7d302a 06c67c9893 is two files: five added lines in tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py (a four-line comment and the queued phase) and a three-line fragment edit; no production module changed, so the product behaviour the previous review scored is untouched.
item_verdicts.done_when: The section-5 done-when's added-failure clause is met by the repair: the test that failed at b1cfbd7d passes 12/12 at head (logs/repair_check_launch_path.log, EXIT=0) and fails again once the repair is reverted (logs/repair-negative-control.log, 1 failed EXIT=1); the routing-importing population itself was not re-run at the repair head, and the repair round's own done-when instead mandated the two 4-passed arms recorded in the manifest.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that a second launch of one run never releases the tree its first launch holds; the reviewed commits are its repair round, and c0ec02d067 answers the blocking finding by keeping the queued request's own pointer in a waiting phase at tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py:105-110 rather than changing the product, which the finding cleared.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest reads complete, records 'acted fece4a4b7c8: c0ec02d067' beside the three commits, and carries baseline_suite at b1cfbd7d and after_suite at 06c67c9893 as 4 passed EXIT=0 with their logs; its after_suite command is the one the repair dispatch mandated rather than the routing population the section done-when names.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The repair round's granted scope in resume-1-advice.txt names tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py and the fragment, and git diff b1cfbd7d302a 06c67c9893 touches exactly those two and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py:118 asserts result['launched'] == [request['run_id']], which reddens with the repair reverted as logs/repair-negative-control.log records (launched [], failed ['r-own-path']); the repair adds no assertion of its own, and the sibling check at line 125 compares the pointer's worktree to the value the test itself wrote, so it holds whatever the launch code does.
justifications.evidence: logs/repair_baseline.log and logs/repair_after.log each record the mandated command at revisions b1cfbd7d and 06c67c9893 as 4 passed EXIT=0, and logs/repair_check_launch_path.log records 12 passed EXIT=0 while logs/repair-negative-control.log shows the reverted repair failing that one id at EXIT=1; the fragment row at line 41 labels that arm 'at repair head' although the log's own header names b1cfbd7d plus an uncommitted repair.
justifications.fit: tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py:104-109 states the mechanism in a four-line comment with no plan, sprint or ticket identifier, and sets the phase through the same _mutate_pointer helper the surrounding cases already use.
justifications.goal_fidelity: c0ec02d067 changes only tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py:105-110, leaving the pointer in the queued phase when the queued request's own path is named, and 06c67c9893 corrects the evidence paragraph at docs/evidence/fragments/a-queued-request-is-checked-when-queued/a-second-launch-of-a-run-never-releases-the-tree-its-first.html:46; the blocking finding fece4a4b7c8 named exactly this defect.
justifications.reuse: the two commits add no definition to extend or duplicate; the only product capability they document, reckon/crew/routing.py:1121 _launch_pointer_worktrees, was added by the previously reviewed commit b1cfbd7d302a.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff b1cfbd7d302a 06c67c9893 changes exactly two files, tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py and the evidence fragment, both named in the repair round's granted write scope in the run's resume-1-advice.txt.
